text: {"claims":[{"quote":"P&G reported group net sales of $86.59 billion, up about 5% reported and roughly 5% organic, with comparable sales growth of about 4%.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"GAAP operating margin was about 20%, and net income was approximately $14.6 billion, or diluted EPS of $6.86.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Operating cash flow was about $12.4 billion.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"For FY2023, ended June 30, 2023, revenue was $82.93 billion, up about 3%, with net income around $14.2 billion and diluted EPS about $5.90; operating margin was roughly 20%.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"For FY2022, ended June 30, 2022, revenue was $80.73 billion, up about 5%, net income was about $14.4 billion, and diluted EPS was about $5.90; operating margin was around 19%.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"The prior years showed resilient cash generation, though currency and currency-neutral growth moderated from the post-pandemic recovery.","verdict":"unchecked"},{"quote":"P&G continued to return cash via dividends and buybacks, with free cash flow still strong.","verdict":"unchecked"},{"quote":"The business appears stable, with pricing power helping margins, but volume growth softened.","verdict":"unchecked"},{"quote":"View: PG shares look fairly valued to slightly undervalued at the 2025-03-31 read.","verdict":"unchecked"}],"action":"block"}
